## Skill and ID

## What the skill or gate said to do

<!-- Quote the rule text, gate check, or instruction as written. Do not paraphrase. -->

## What happened

<!-- The wrong output or wrong result: what was produced, what the gate passed or failed that it should not have, or what broke when the instruction was followed exactly. Paste the relevant output or error. -->

## What should have happened

<!-- The correct result, and the source that establishes it (documentation link, specification, or the conflicting rule elsewhere in this repo — name that rule's ID too if two rules disagree). -->

## Context

<!-- Project type / playbook in use, which other skills were loaded at the time, and the repo version (see VERSION and CHANGELOG.md). -->
